method: Unthrottled local Vite production preview, 1600x1000 CSS px DPR1, real Chromium Performance APIs and CDP Network. Cold=new browser context plus cleared HTTP cache; warm=same context normal reload with cache enabled. OS filesystem, GPU driver shader caches and server process are not cold. No claim about WAN/device-independent speed. No product files, core images, texture size or bytes changed.

httpServer: Vite production preview; actual Cache-Control/Content-Encoding recorded per CDP response; no custom cache simulation.

analysis.method: Derived only from the recorded actual runs. CDP loadingFinished encodedDataLength includes document/headers; Resource Timing totals exclude document and use browser header-size accounting. Resource encodedBodySize is not summed as downloaded bytes because re-used cached entity metadata can appear on multiple entries. deliveryType=cache and actual 304 responses are recorded independently of the strict transferSize===0 heuristic.

coreImagePreservation.policy: Core author paintings/textures/covers are immutable: no resize, recompression, crop, colour change or replacement; performance suggestions concern loading/hosting/deployment selection only.
coreImagePreservation.bytesNotPixels: Current texture containers match frozen inputs byte-for-byte. This audit does not replace the earlier full-resolution RGBA/source fidelity test.
